tonight.headline: Now a slight favourite, but only because JuiceJam are starting a zero
body: Week 3 hasn't started. ESPN now projects you 120.0 to JuiceJam's 115.8, a 52% win probability, up from 45% this morning. You didn't change anything to get there: ESPN dropped Nico Collins' projection to 0.0, and JuiceJam still have him in their lineup.

Don't count on it lasting. If they put Jameson Williams (11.0) in for Collins, they lead by about 7. Your lineup is already the projection lineup. The Tate move you made at 16:39 UTC was the last free change. Both fallback cards below wait for Saturday.

case.label: Why Collins is zero
case.body: Grade 1 hamstring. He missed his third straight session on Wednesday, and SI (23 Sep) say the signs point to another absence, with Week 4 at Dallas the likelier return.

case.label: Where the gap really is
case.body: Gibbs and Walker project 46.5 between them against your 38.1 at RB. No lineup move closes that. Tucker Kraft plays for them tonight.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Collins is active on Sunday, or JuiceJam move Jameson Williams in. Either way ESPN's 52% goes back under 50, and the real edge was never there.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only. Decide on Saturday's Bears report, before Gadsden's 11:00 Sunday kickoff
doFirst.title: Only if the Bears list Williams out or doubtful: start Gadsden over Loveland
doFirst.subtitle: Not armed, but it's getting more likely to be needed. Williams missed practice again Thursday. Chicago's official designations for a Monday game come out Saturday.

case.label: The evidence, now two days of it
case.body: Caleb Williams (hamstring) didn't practise Thursday (NBC Sports) after a walkthrough-only Wednesday. Ben Johnson said he doesn't expect him to practise this week. Tyson Bagent is in the concussion protocol. Case Keenum, who last played on Christmas Eve 2023, is tracking toward the start (Bleacher Nation, 23 Sep).

case.label: Loveland's usage
case.body: 1 catch for 3 yards on 5 targets through two games (CBS). He's being kept in to block. Philadelphia have allowed the 3rd-fewest TE points so far (footballdb, two games).

case.label: Gadsden's side
case.body: The Chargers' only active tight end, with Njoku and Kolar on IR (Chargers.com, 21 Sep; not re-checked today). Buffalo have allowed the 12th-most TE points (footballdb).

case.label: Why not now
case.body: ESPN still projects Loveland 9.7 to Gadsden 8.7, and the only legitimate override is a named quarterback change. That becomes official when Chicago name Keenum or rule Williams out. Both players are on your roster, so waiting costs nothing until Gadsden kicks off.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Williams is a full participant Friday or Saturday. The card then never fires and costs nothing.

doFirst.sources: NBC Sports · Bleacher Nation · CBS Sports · footballdb · Chargers.com

action.label: Start Gadsden · bench Loveland (only if Williams is out)

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only. Decide on Saturday's Eagles report, before Tuten's 11:00 Sunday kickoff
doFirst.title: Only if Philadelphia rule Barkley out or doubtful: start Tuten
doFirst.subtitle: Not armed, and less likely to be needed than this morning. Barkley practised Thursday.

case.label: What changed today
case.body: Barkley practised Thursday wearing a 'cowboy collar' to protect the neck (The Athletic via RotoWire). NBC Sports Philadelphia read his test results as positive and called it a good sign for Monday. His official participation level hadn't been published.

case.label: The timing trap
case.body: Barkley plays Monday and Tuten plays Sunday. If Barkley is still questionable going into Monday, Tuten has already locked. Standing policy: a top-12 back who is only questionable starts. Only OUT or DOUBTFUL moves him.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Barkley is listed full on Friday or carries no designation on Saturday. The card then never fires.

action.label: Start Tuten · bench Barkley (only if Barkley is out)

whatWentWrong.title: Loveland has scored 1.4 points in two games, and your tight-end seat now depends on Chicago's quarterback
whatWentWrong.lead: 0.7 a game on 3 and 4.5 opportunities, while ESPN still ranks him TE11. That gap is why the first card exists.

case.label: What happened
case.body: He leads the Bears in routes but has been kept in to block (CBS). The waiver tool flags him FALLING, meaning low usage in every week there's data for, not a one-week slump.

case.label: What it changes
case.body: You already bought the fix on 24 Sep: Gadsden, for nothing. The first card only decides when to use him.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Loveland draws six or more targets on Monday with Keenum. That would say the blocking role was about the game plan, not a role he's stuck in.

roster.footnote: Golden and Lloyd play tonight at 18:15 Mexico City, on the bench, which is correct by projection. Barkley and Loveland play Monday at 18:15. Grades use footballdb's 2026 points-allowed table (standard scoring, two games, 1st = fewest allowed). That's a thin sample. Kicker and D/ST aren't graded.

starting.detail: JAX · vs NE · SUN 11:00 · No ESPN injury tag. Not re-researched this run. Your only quarterback. New England have allowed the 3rd-fewest QB points. That's a thin sample, and it doesn't change who starts.

starting.name: Jonathan Taylor

starting.detail: KC · at MIA · SUN 11:00 · Full practice Thursday with the knee tag, like Mahomes (104.7 The Cave). This game decides the sell-high thesis.

starting.detail: TEN · at NYG · SUN 11:00 · Cam Ward throwing. Not re-researched this run. This morning: 11 targets in two games, but Ward threw only 20 passes in Week 2 (CBS, NBC). In the flex by projection, 11.8 to Vele's 11.6.

starting.name: Colston Loveland
starting.detail: CHI · vs PHI · MON 18:15 · READ THIS · Caleb Williams missed practice again Thursday (NBC Sports). Case Keenum is tracking toward the start (Bleacher Nation), with Bagent in the concussion protocol. 1 catch on 5 targets so far (CBS).

starting.detail: NYG · vs TEN · SUN 11:00 · Brian Burns didn't practise Wednesday and is out for the week (Giants.com). This morning's source had them FantasyPros DST10.

starting.detail: SEA · at WSH · SUN 11:00 · PFN's updated board (22 Sep) has him K5 against a Washington team starting Mariota. The best free agent, Trey Smack, is K4. One rank isn't worth a move. Hold.

bench.detail: JAX · vs NE · SUN 11:00 · No ESPN tag; I didn't check the Jaguars' Thursday report. Barkley's cover and the piece in the Lamar offer.

bench.detail: GB · vs ATL · THU 18:15 · Plays TONIGHT, on the bench. Josh Jacobs is still on the Commissioner's Exempt List and misses tonight (AtoZ Sports, 24 Sep). Lindy's expect Lloyd to be the most-used back.

bench.name: Matthew Golden
bench.detail: GB · vs ATL · THU 18:15 · Plays TONIGHT, on the bench. Jayden Reed (neck) is out indefinitely; Lindy's call Golden a weekly WR2/WR3 now. Projected 11.4, below Tate's 11.8, so the flex stays with Tate. That's a coin flip, so take the projection.

bench.name: Devaughn Vele
bench.detail: NO · vs LV · SUN 14:25 · Tyler Shough throwing; Sharp Football have New Orleans implied at 23.5. Benched at 16:39 for Tate on projection. Las Vegas have allowed the 5th-fewest WR points.

bench.name: Oronde Gadsden
bench.detail: LAC · at BUF · SUN 11:00 · The Chargers' only active tight end, with Njoku and Kolar on IR (Chargers.com, 21 Sep; not re-checked today). He starts if Chicago's quarterback falls through (first card).

trades.theirGainLine: Their gain is +1.6 a week. Tuten replaces Rachaad White's 9.4 at RB2, and Lamar scores them nothing sitting behind Josh Allen.

case.label: Re-checked this afternoon
case.body: Recomputed from the 21:53 snapshot, not copied from this morning. Lamar is still in slot 20 behind Allen in slot 0, and White still starts at RB2. Bloodsports' best lineup goes 120.1 to 123.8; Team 13's goes 123.6 to 125.2.

case.label: What moved today
case.body: Barkley practised Thursday (RotoWire). The one falsifier that could have made Tuten a forced starter this week is further away.

case.label: Honest risk
case.body: On season projections it's lopsided: Lamar 297.3, Tuten 166.9. That's why it's a longshot. It only works for them on a weekly lineup view. It also takes Barkley's cover off your roster.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Team 13 start a second real back or trade a quarterback, Lamar lands on Baltimore's report, or Barkley is ruled out and Tuten has to start. Don't send it again; only respond if they open the conversation.

trades.copyText: Hi, would you do Lamar for Bhayshul Tuten? Lamar sits behind Allen and can't score for you, and Tuten goes straight into your RB2 ahead of White. That's about +1.6 a week to your lineup. Propose it in ESPN if you're in.

worthALook.name: Josh Downs
worthALook.lead: The injury worry from this morning didn't hold up. Still not an add today.

case.label: The role
case.body: Alec Pierce is on IR with the heel, a minimum of four games (Colts Thursday report via Yahoo). Downs isn't on that report, so the injury headline this morning's brief couldn't check looks like August's calf, not a new problem.

case.label: Why not now
case.body: He'd need a bench seat. The only clearable ones are Golden and Lloyd, who both play tonight; Vele, who was just benched; and seats that changed hands in the last seven days. Houston have allowed the 2nd-fewest RB points but the most WR points, which helps Downs. That's one week's matchup, not a role.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Next week, if Golden's role shrinks tonight or Tate stays under five targets on Sunday. He's a free agent, so it costs no priority.

worthALook.name: Adonai Mitchell
worthALook.lead: The receiver taking targets from your own starter, and now he's on the injury report.

case.label: The role
case.body: Team-high 12 targets in Week 2. The Jets are down to four healthy receivers (The Jet Press, 24 Sep).

case.label: The new risk
case.body: Added to Thursday's report as limited with a finger injury. He wasn't on Wednesday's. If he sits, those targets go to Garrett Wilson, who you start.

case.label: When to act
case.body: If he again out-targets Wilson at Detroit. Wrong if Wilson draws nine or more targets and Mitchell fewer than six.

worthALook.name: Panthers D/ST
worthALook.lead: The defence comparison, answered hold for now.

case.label: The comparison
case.body: ESPN here has Carolina 7.3 to the Giants' 7.1. That's a 0.2 gap, and the Giants have lost Brian Burns for the week.

case.label: The problem
case.body: Devin Lloyd (calf) and Jaelan Phillips (back) didn't practise Wednesday (Athlon). I couldn't find Thursday's Panthers report.

case.label: When to act
case.body: If Lloyd and Phillips both practise fully on Friday. It's a free-agent swap, so no priority.

doNotChase.name: Tyler Shough
doNotChase.lead: He projects above Lawrence and he's free. The case for him is two box scores.

case.label: The case for
case.body: QB8 two weeks running despite poor first halves, and New Orleans are implied at 23.5 against Las Vegas (Sharp Football). ESPN projects him 17.7 to Lawrence's 16.4.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: The case is two box scores. This quarterback slot lost 42.8 points in two weeks by chasing box scores. Lawrence has no injury, and Shough's matchup isn't softer: Las Vegas have allowed the 6th-fewest QB points, New England the 3rd-fewest (footballdb).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Lawrence getting hurt. Then Shough is the free-agent answer, and you have no back-up quarterback on the roster.

doNotChase.sources: Sharp Football · footballdb · ESPN league file

doNotChase.name: Josh Jacobs
doNotChase.lead: The best-looking name on the wire, and he isn't playing.

case.label: The fact
case.body: Still on the Commissioner's Exempt List and misses tonight. On 24 Sep a court declined to seal the evidence, which AtoZ Sports say could affect how long he's suspended. ESPN labels him DAY_TO_DAY with a 167.6 season projection, and neither reflects any of that.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: The NFL reinstating him AND Green Bay activating him. Even then, Lloyd is already on your roster.

doNotChase.name: Tank Bigsby
doNotChase.lead: A handcuff to your own back, and Thursday made him less useful.

case.label: The fact
case.body: His whole rise, 1 to 16 opportunities, came while Barkley played 16% of Week 2 with the stinger. Barkley practised Thursday (RotoWire).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley ruled out for more than a week, with Bigsby named the lead back. Tuten covers first either way.

waiverAnalysis.summary: Eight risers and two fallers from two weeks of data, which is a thin sample. None is an add today. Bateman has the strongest role reason this afternoon, but he doesn't start for you and there's no open seat.

rising.name: Rashod Bateman
rising.roleReason: Zay Flowers didn't practise Wednesday and SI (24 Sep) call him unlikely for Week 3. Bateman played 93% of snaps and went 7-9-88-1 without Flowers. The role lasts only while Flowers is out.
rising.action: WATCH — A free agent until Sunday 14:25; the decision is Friday's Flowers ruling, and even then he has no seat over Tate or Vele

rising.name: Adonai Mitchell
rising.roleReason: Real volume in a receiver room down to four: Cooper has a high ankle sprain, Arian Smith an ACL tear. New: limited Thursday with a finger injury (The Jet Press)
rising.action: WATCH — No open seat, and a new injury tag

rising.name: Josh Downs
rising.roleReason: Alec Pierce is on IR for at least four games (Colts report via Yahoo). Downs isn't on the Thursday report
rising.action: WATCH — The role holds, but he projects below Tate and Vele and there's no seat

rising.name: Xavier Hutchinson
rising.roleReason: Moves up only while Nico Collins is out. SI (23 Sep) expect another Collins absence, but the volume runs through Dalton Schultz, and Hutchinson, Boutte and Noel combined for seven catches in Week 2
rising.action: WATCH — At best he's filling in for an injured player, and he isn't in the league file's wire list

rising.name: Woody Marks
rising.roleReason: No 2026 reporting found on his share of the backfield. Volume that hasn't produced, which STRATEGY section 2 calls a warning. Houston's opponent has allowed the 3rd-most RB points

rising.name: Tank Bigsby
rising.roleReason: All of the rise came while Barkley played 16% with a stinger. Barkley practised Thursday in a cowboy collar (RotoWire). A handcuff, not a breakout
rising.action: HOLD off — Tuten covers Barkley first

rising.name: Jonah Coleman
rising.roleReason: You dropped him on 24 Sep. He didn't practise Wednesday with the ankle, while Dobbins and Harvey were limited (ESPN, PFT). I found no Thursday update
rising.action: WATCH — Re-adding him would reverse a drop made one day ago

rising.name: Brian Robinson Jr.
rising.roleReason: Not re-researched this run. This morning's source (PFN, 20 Sep): Bijan Robinson's backup, a stash only if Bijan gets hurt
rising.action: WATCH — No path to a lead role

falling.name: Colston Loveland
falling.roleReason: Leads the Bears in routes but is kept in to block, 1 catch on 5 targets (CBS). Caleb Williams missed practice again Thursday (NBC) and Keenum is tracking toward the start
falling.action: HOLD — Gadsden is the fallback start if Williams is out

falling.name: Oronde Gadsden
falling.roleReason: His two low weeks came behind Njoku and Kolar. Both are now on IR and he's the Chargers' only active tight end (Chargers.com, 21 Sep). The role expands from Week 3
falling.action: HOLD — The tool is reading the old depth chart
